_comment: All coordinates are in PDF points (1/72 inch), ReportLab's coordinate system: origin (0,0) is the bottom-left corner of the page. This file is the single source of truth for both PDF rendering (app/services/pdf_gen.py) and, in Phase 5/6, OMR bubble-region alignment.

fiducials._comment: Four solid black squares near each page corner, drawn identically on every page. Phase 5 OMR alignment (app/ml/omr/align.py) detects these to compute a homography correcting scan rotation/skew before any bubble coordinate is trusted. Positions are corner-anchored: margin_from_edge_pt from each page edge to the square's near edges. size_pt is deliberately well above a QR finder-pattern's outer-square size (~17pt for this project's qr_box/qr_id length) so area-based detection can't confuse the two.

qr_box._comment: Fixed top-right corner on every page, so a page can always be identified even if scanned out of order or separated from the rest of the packet.

name_field._comment: Ruled line for the student to handwrite their name. Page 1 only (app/services/pdf_gen.py only calls _draw_name_field for page_index == 0) - the scan pipeline doesn't support multi-page versions yet (see app/routers/scan.py), so every other page is unscoreable regardless. crop_*_pt is deliberately taller than the ruled line itself, to catch ascenders/descenders of handwriting above and below it; it's what app/ml/omr/name_ocr.py crops for OCR via geometry.name_field_pixel_rect.
name_field.label: Name:

_comment_bubble_grid: Question rows form a uniform grid. For question at zero-based row index r on a page (r = position_on_page), the row's baseline y is first_question_y_pt - r * row_height_pt. Question text is drawn at (question_text_x_pt, row_y + question_text_dy_pt). Option bubble i (0-based, i-th shuffled option, labeled A/B/C/...) is a circle of radius bubble_radius_pt centered at (option_start_x_pt + i * option_spacing_x_pt, row_y + bubble_dy_pt), with its letter label drawn bubble_label_dx_pt to the left of the circle center.
